Advertising & Referral Disclosure

American Shingle Co. (1-stop-roofing.com) operates as a commercial advertising and referral matching service for residential property owners seeking roofing services.

How American Shingle Co. Is Compensated

1-stop-roofing.com is a free resource for homeowners. To maintain our website, provide editorial content, and operate our phone intake routing system without charging consumers, we receive financial compensation directly from independent roofing contractors who participate in our referral network.

Compensation occurs when a property owner requests an estimate or places a call that connects with a participating contractor in their local geographic area. This compensation does not affect the price you pay for roofing services; partner contractors agree not to add referral markups to homeowner proposals.

Independent Contractor Relationship

American Shingle Co. is not a licensed general contractor or roofing company and does not employ construction crews or perform roofing labor. Participating contractors are independent third parties who operate their own businesses and hold their own required trade licenses, registrations, and insurance policies.

We do not warrant or guarantee any specific work performed by independent contractors. We encourage all property owners to independently verify contractor credentials, local municipal licenses, and insurance certificates prior to signing agreements or issuing deposits.
